A '''battle''' occurred sometime on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hosko]] during the [[Hutt Cataclysms]], a civil war that ravaged the [[Hutt Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], farmers on Hosko discovered buried weapons and [[Droid/Legends|droids]] from the battle.<ref name="Under Hosko's Fields" />
